name: Hanged Man
intro: The Hanged Man pathway draws on secrets, sacrifice, corruption and the powers of the shadow. It can exploit other abilities and transform knowledge into dangerous strength.

meter.name: Depravity
meter.gain: Grazing a genuinely defeated Beyonder soul
meter.full: One paid use of a grazed ability

ability.name: Blood Supplication
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Blood Supplication — Restores 10% of damage dealt by basic strikes. Passive.

ability.name: Shadow Strike
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Shadow Strike — Deals 135% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Shadow damage (22% base DEF bypass); +15% DEF bypass on this cast; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Flesh Healing
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Flesh Healing — Immediately restores 15% Max HP HP, capped at Max HP; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Depravity Mark
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Depravity Mark — Target takes +30% incoming damage for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 65% basic strike against the current enemy. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Soul Drain
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Soul Drain — Deals 210% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Blood damage (22% base DEF bypass); Immediately drains up to 15 target SP; From Sequence 5, your kills grant one random compatible active or passive ability per soul. Keep five souls permanently at every Sequence. At 100 charge, invoke a retained power with normal payment; passives require a paid two-turn manifestation.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Shadow Sword Execution
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Shadow Sword Execution — Deals 190% ATK + 35% INT Shadow damage (22% base DEF bypass); Restores 30% of damage dealt by this cast; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Flesh Creation
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Flesh Creation — Grants a 25% Max HP shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 65 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Devouring Shadow
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Devouring Shadow — Deals 310% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Shadow damage (22% base DEF bypass); Restores 25% of damage dealt by this cast; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Degeneration Aura
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Degeneration Aura — Enemy ATK −20% while you are alive; Enemy DEF −20% while you are alive. Passive.

ability.name: Divine Depravity
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Divine Depravity — Targets all enemies; Deals 410% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 125 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
